C002:143.summary: Elevated risk identified across radiation, inflammatory, cardiovascular, sleep, and psychosocial domains.
drivers: Solar particle event acute radiation spike (9.0 mSv)
Cardiovascular strain: resting HR elevated (65 bpm) and HRV depressed (59 ms)
Reported isolation stress and mood rating decline

suggestedActions.title: Solar Particle Event Habitat Storm Shelter
suggestedActions.protocol: Immediately relocate crew to heavily shielded central storm shelter modules upon solar particle event alerts. Remain in sheltered configuration until active dosimeter telemetry measures baseline transit levels (<2.0 mSv/day).

suggestedActions.title: Cardiac Pacing and Workload Adjustment
suggestedActions.protocol: Reduce mission operational physical workload for crew exhibiting sustained elevated resting heart rate or suppressed HRV. Introduce dedicated restorative rest periods to allow autonomic stabilization.

suggestedActions.title: Autonomic Deconditioning and Fluid Rebalancing
suggestedActions.protocol: Ingest monitored fluid and electrolyte countermeasure solutions to counter microgravity-induced cephalad fluid shifts. Utilize lower body compression garments to support venous return and relieve cardiac strain.
